effect_description_eng:
[All Turns] When you hatch in the breeding area, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] By returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Tai Kamiya] or [Kari Kamiya] in its name from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
